deals.evidence:
Happy Hour:M-Th, 3-6PM
Looking for the best happy hour in Dallas? Hopdoddy hosts the happiest of them all with 1/2 off cocktails, beer & wine Monday through Thursday from 3-6PM.

notes: McKinney Ave page lists happy hour M-Th 3-6PM with half-off cocktails, beer & wine (the general happy hour page also says sliders are half off). The 'M-F 3-6PM' banner is addressed to Austin. No location page provided for Luther Ln, so it is not included.
